summary: Measured CPU and memory while awake, hot storage while awake and cold storage for as long as data is kept.
notes: Memory is billed on actual use; the calculator uses the memory you entered.
The $1 trial credit and the under-$5 personal-org waiver are not subtracted.
The free 20 GB of cold storage per organisation a month is not subtracted, so stored-disk totals are up to about $0.39 a month high.
The pricing page's Markdown version says no plan is picked up front; the FAQ and changelog sell eight tiers from Adventurer ($20) to Mythic ($2,000). Pay as you go is used here.

upkeep.label: What you keep up
upkeep.detail: Sprites are kept, and Fly says long-lived ones still need regular updates from you, including the bundled agents and language tools.

source.quote: Sprites are persistent. Everything you leave is there when you come back, including the software. Long-living Sprites still need regular updates.
